title: Quarterly Sprint Bridge & OKR Pack for Private Edge Enablement
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Create a compact, cross-functional quarterly plan (sprint bridge) and OKR pack to move Private Edge Enablement from early integrations to a tested, canary-ready offering. This ticket centralizes milestones, risk mitigations, and clear acceptance criteria for the quarter so Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success can align onboarding commitments.
Background: multiple private/VPC/on-prem requests require enabling smaller edge footprints (single-rack, air-gapped variants) and tighter KMS/HSM integrations. We must sequence infra, runtime, deployment automation, and docs to avoid last-minute scope creep and missed SLAs.
Objectives:
1) Define three measurable OKRs for the quarter tied to canary readiness, operational runbooks, and cost-per-token targets.
2) Produce a sprint-level plan with owner assignments and gating criteria.
3) Identify and lock critical dependencies (kernel matrix, KMS integration, upgrade runbook).
4) Produce a customer-facing activation checklist and a rollback playbook.
Scope (in-scope):
- Private Edge packaging (installers + manifests)
- Minimal cloud control-plane integration for VPC-lite
- KMS/HSM onboarding flows and audit sample events
- Autoscaling guardrails for low-footprint GPUs
- Compatibility signals with runtime-1.24 changes
Out-of-scope:
- Full scale Dedicated fleet work (handled under PM-46821)
- Non-enterprise sandbox UIs
Acceptance criteria:
- OKR pack shared with Exec and ratified by PM and Eng leads.
- Sprint bridge (6 sprints) uploaded to Confluence and linked from Console roadmap.
- Two enterprise customers committed to a Q2 canary cohort with signed activation windows.
- KMS integration tested end-to-end in private staging and logged in audit trail.
- Upgrade rollback validated in a simulated isolated environment with defined MTTR targets.
Success metrics:
- Canary cohort activation within window for >=1 customer.
- Mean token latency within agreed SLO for edge profile (<120ms p95).
- Deployment failure rate during canary <=2% across nodes.
acceptance_criteria: OKR pack reviewed and approved by Product, Eng, Security
Sprint bridge (6 sprint breakdown) uploaded to Confluence with owners and risk flags
KMS/HSM end-to-end test in private staging with audit entries captured
Canary cohort activation plan signed by CS and customer with rollback window defined
Compatibility tests with runtime-1.24 run against representative models and quantized variants

KMS/HSM vendor onboarding may require legal review and delay activation
Customer network configurations for on-prem edge introduce unpredictable latencies
Insufficient infra capacity in targeted regions for canary scale
